title: Federal Tax Credits for Energy Efficiency
summary: ENERGY STAR's 2025 page on the federal home efficiency and clean energy tax credits, available through December 31, 2025.

assertions.quote: These energy efficient home improvement credits are available for 30% of costs - up to $2,000
a 30 percent income tax credit for clean energy equipment, such as rooftop solar, wind energy, geothermal heat pumps and battery storage
